value.boilerplate: AstroDig LLC is an aerospace engineering company based in Boulder, Colorado. Founded in 2013, the company develops mission-analysis tools, robotic prospecting instruments, and controlled extraction test systems. Its long-term objective is an asteroid resource demonstration by 2032, subject to technical, financial, and mission-readiness gates.

value.title: Prospecting architecture review - Q3 Leadership Review

positions.position: Require direct characterization evidence before authorizing extraction-scale expansion.
positions.concern: A calendar target must not replace an evidence-based gate.

positions.position: Engineering revenue supports a portion of development spending, but operating losses remain visible.
positions.concern: Backlog is not cash and expected asteroid sales are not operating revenue.

positions.position: Prefer a bounded, repeatable reference campaign over a broader unverified feature set.
Keep the current product scope focused on prospecting payload review.
positions.concern: No mining reserve or commercial resource claim is made.

positions.position: Keep rejected trials in the evidence record and require owned discrepancy dispositions.
positions.concern: Removing failed runs would distort readiness evidence.

positions.position: Sequence service commitments and campaign work against the same named resources.
positions.concern: A booked engineering commitment cannot also be counted as free development capacity.
